mode.reason: Semantic vector default; deterministic exact/identifier hybrid; validate current BGE-M3 domain shift.

candidate_k.reason: Retain existing bounded recall depth; no grid.

top_k.reason: Round 1 answer-context depth; bounded local context.

source_weights.meaning: Sum weight/(k+1-based source rank); not raw similarity.

rerank_enabled.reason: Optional port, no resident heavy model on 8 GB GPU.

mmr_enabled.reason: Optional port; no unvalidated MMR or embedding calls.

query_rewrite_enabled.reason: No general rewrite adapter; q0 remains available.

query_expansion_enabled.reason: Existing opt-in local expansion only after empty recall.

local_answer_enabled.reason: Existing local Ollama generation; can be disabled.

cloud_fallback_enabled.reason: Execution interface only; no cloud adapter or automatic policy.

thresholds.reason: Current term-frequency keyword scores are not BM25 or RAGFlow token-similarity scores.
